rules.question: Is this chart format a container (one file holding the notes and the audio)?
rules.note: Catches a second list of the container formats written as an either-or test. A switch that names each format on its own case line spells no pair, so text cannot catch it; the scan's chart_kind_of in app/analysis.cpp is one, and tells the hasher which reader to use. A test of one format alone (is it a .sng) is a different question and is not flagged. Decided by: D114, concept audit finding M63
